# D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited

> D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is one of Kenya's leading petrol station installation companies. We design and build complete petrol stations from the ground up, supply certified petroleum equipment, carry out tank fabrication and repairs, and provide ongoing maintenance and compliance support across all 47 counties of Kenya.

## About

D'Zizi Petroleum Services Limited is a fully licensed petroleum engineering firm based in Nairobi, Kenya. We are EPRA (Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority) compliant and serve petroleum operators, fuel retailers, industrial depots, and commercial fleet owners across the country.

- **Founded**: Over 10 years in the petroleum industry
- **Headquarters**: Nairobi, Kenya
- **Contact**: +254 702 587 919
- **Email**: info@dzizipetroleum.co.ke
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/254702587919
- **Website**: https://dzizipetroleum.co.ke

## Core Services

### Petrol Station Installation Kenya
We are one of Kenya's most experienced petrol station installation companies, handling complete turnkey builds: site assessment, civil works coordination, underground tank installation, fuel line laying, dispenser installation, canopy setup, and EPRA inspection readiness. We have delivered successful petrol station installations in Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu, Eldoret, Nakuru, and across all major towns in Kenya.

### Tank Fabrication Kenya
Custom steel above-ground tank (AST) fabrication to client specifications, plus structural repairs for underground (UST) and above-ground storage tanks. Services include internal lining, coating, post-repair hydrotesting and re-calibration with EPRA-accepted certificates. We are one of the key tank fabrication companies operating in Kenya.

### Underground Fuel Tank Installation
Supply and installation of double-wall fibreglass and steel underground storage tanks (USTs) in sizes from 10,000 L to 40,000 L and above. All tanks are EPRA and NEMA compliant.

### Fuel Dispenser Installation
Supply, installation and commissioning of single-nozzle, twin-nozzle and multi-product fuel dispensers. WMA-calibrated flow meters, full training and ongoing spares support.

### Fuel Piping Systems
Installation, repair and maintenance of suction lines, vent lines and offloading pipework using EPRA-approved HDPE and double-wall flexible pipe. All pipework pressure-tested with certified reports.

### Tank Hydrotesting Kenya
Pre-commissioning and periodic pressure testing of underground and above-ground fuel storage tanks. EPRA-accepted hydrotest certificates issued.

### Tank Calibration Kenya
Wet and dry calibration services for USTs and ASTs. WMA-compliant calibration certificates essential for EPRA licensing.

### EPRA Compliance Support
We guide petroleum business owners through the EPRA licensing process, preparing technical documentation, attending inspections and resolving compliance deficiencies.

### Petrol Station Maintenance Kenya
Scheduled and emergency maintenance for petrol station forecourts. Available 24/7 for emergency breakdowns across Kenya.

### Petroleum Equipment Sales
Full range of EPRA-aligned petroleum equipment: underground and above-ground storage tanks, fuel dispensers, submersible pumps, ATGs, air compressors, standby generators and fuel management systems.

### Commercial Site Fuel System Maintenance
Full-service maintenance contracts for fuel depots, industrial yards, mining sites, and commercial fleet fuelling points.

### Canopy Fabrication & Installation
Custom design, steel fabrication and on-site installation of petrol station forecourt canopies, including lighting and brand signage integration.

### Other Services
Fuel line pressure testing, petrol station electrical installation, branding works, pump spare parts, transportation of petroleum equipment.
